newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends down on strong US dlr overseas.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends down on strong US dlr overseas.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed slightly lower against its U.S. counterpart on Saturday, reflecting the strength of the U.S. dollar overseas, dealers said.
The local unit ended at T$27.472 against Friday's T$27.468 close. Turnover was a slow US$76 million.

But dealers noted foreign fund entries. "The Taiwan dollar should fall much further due to the surging U.S. dollar overseas, but foreign fund inflows emerged to offset the fall," said one dealer. For next week, a T$27.40-27.50 range was seen on expected foreign fund inflows as Morgan Stanley includes Taiwan in its global indices on Monday.
